violations.text: Cookies cooked and packaged in the food establishment and set for customer self-selection are lacking proper labels. Food packaged in a food establishment and set for customer self-selection must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. PIC is to keep the cookies behind the pos in a way to hand the cookies to the customer until proper labels can be applied. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The front door to the outside is not tight-fitting (gap at base of door). Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Door sweep to be added to close the gap preventing possible entry of pests. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Prepped "to-go" containers are not stored inverted. Containers are to be stored inverted to prevent the possible contamination of the food contact side of containers during storage. Employee inverted items for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. At time of inspection, sanitizer was not installed and will be installed within the week. PIC got bleach at time of inspection. Proof of service to be sent to inspector. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/02/2026
